verdicts.file: the model files on disk are damaged or incomplete
verdicts.config: the model's own config / tokenizer / chat template files are wrong
verdicts.request: something in the request the client sent (fields, stop strings, token limits, format, thinking switch)
verdicts.sampling: the decoding settings (temperature, penalties, greedy vs sampled)
verdicts.runtime: the serving runtime or its launch flags (cache, context handling, server-side template, projector)
verdicts.quantisation: damage introduced by quantising the weights
verdicts.provider: a hosted provider's filter, refusal field or rate limit
verdicts.known_bug: a documented upstream bug in this model or runtime version
verdicts.weight_level: the behaviour is in the trained weights; no setting, file or runtime cause explains it
verdicts.inconclusive: the evidence given is not enough to name a cause yet

fix_actions.set_param: set a request / sampling parameter to a value (target = parameter name, value = new value)
fix_actions.remove_param: remove a request / sampling parameter (target = parameter name)
fix_actions.change_stop: change or remove stop strings / stop tokens (target = what to change)
fix_actions.change_request_format: send the same content in a different request shape (target = field)
fix_actions.change_template: fix or replace the chat template (target = file or flag)
fix_actions.disable_thinking: turn the model's thinking / reasoning mode off for this request
fix_actions.raise_max_tokens: allow more output tokens (value = new limit)
fix_actions.change_runtime_flag: change a server launch flag or runtime setting (target = flag)
fix_actions.change_quant: use a different quantisation of the same model (value = quant type)
fix_actions.redownload: re-download or re-convert the model files
fix_actions.use_sampling: switch from greedy decoding to sampled decoding
fix_actions.weight_edit_or_finetune: change the model's weights (targeted edit or fine-tuning)
fix_actions.collect_more_evidence: run a specific further experiment before fixing anything (target = experiment)

codes.description: truncated / partial download, bad shard index, NaN or Inf in weights, checksum differs from upstream
chat template is outdated or differs from the upstream template for this model
no chat template, so the prompt is sent as raw text
the configured end-of-sequence token is not the token the template ends a turn with
the prompt starts with two beginning-of-sequence tokens
converted file uses a default pre-tokenizer instead of the model's own
a stop string in the request matches early in normal output
max_tokens is too small for the requested answer
the model's thinking / reasoning uses the output budget before the answer starts
the image is sent in a field this API does not read, so the model never receives it
an assistant prefill contains reasoning markup this model does not use
the prompt is longer than the context window and is silently truncated
a grammar / JSON schema constraint forces degenerate tokens
temperature is high enough to sample nonsense tokens
repetition penalty is strong enough to stop the model reusing ordinary words or structure
frequency or presence penalty at an extreme value
min_p so high that only the top token survives
greedy decoding falls into a repeat that sampled decoding escapes
the server quantises the KV cache, which degrades long outputs
the server shifted / dropped early context mid-generation
a reused prompt cache gives a different reply than a fresh evaluation
the server renders a different template than the model files define
the server runs without the vision projector, so images are not encoded
a low-bit quant of the model damaged its behaviour
a hosted provider's content filter blocked or emptied the reply
a hosted provider rate-limited or errored
a documented bug in this model release or runtime version
the trained model refuses a benign request
the trained model cannot produce the requested language well
another behaviour that lives in the weights
the artifacts do not show the failure or do not separate the causes
the output is correct for the request
